libdot: test: fix chai test detection

Both lib.assert & nassh/js/nasftp_cli.js use chai in the global namespace
to detect whether we're running unittests or production code.  This broke
a year ago when we upgraded to chai v5 which switched from global imports
to ES6 modules.  The nasftp code wasn't logging as verbosely during tests
(which isn't a big deal), and all of our libdot-based asserts were skipped
during tests.  The latter is not good, but since we haven't broken any of
the tests, it's OK to re-enable so the asserts actually assert.
